t: This memorial on the Victoria Embankment marks Queen Victoria's last visit to the City of London, and it depicts her. The sculptor was Charles Henry Mabey, who also worked as a medallist. Victoria reigned for 63 years and 216 days, longer than any of her predecessors. Her reign gave its name to the Victorian era, a time of industrial, political, scientific and military change, and of great expansion of the British Empire. In 1876 Parliament granted her the additional title of Empress of India.
